summary: Values sent with outer next after a delegated yield are forwarded to the inner iterator next method.

semantics.subsequent_normal_resume: Call inner next with received value

tests.name: sent value reaches inner generator
tests.input: function* inner(){console.log(yield 1)} function* outer(){yield* inner()} const it=outer();it.next();it.next(7);

tests.name: first outer next argument not forwarded
tests.input: function* inner(){console.log(yield 1)} function* outer(){yield* inner()} const it=outer();it.next(9);it.next(3);
